摘要：成对的合成孔径雷达（SAR）与光电（EO）影像在多种传感器、分辨率和地理区域中日益可得。然而，现有 SAR 到 EO 图像翻译（SET）方法通常仅在单一、规模有限的数据集上训练，导致模型专用于特定传感条件。我们提出 GeoSET，这是首个用于 SET 的通用模型，其围绕一个单一预训练父模型构建，并在统一协议下适配到下游数据集。我们从超过 1000 万条 SAR 观测中整理出超过 300 万对高质量 SAR–EO 图像对，涵盖多种传感器、空间分辨率和地面采样距离。为弥合 SAR 观测与预训练图像生成器之间的模态差距，我们开发了一种抗斑点噪声的 SAR 编码器，并在此异构语料库上预训练条件生成器。所得父模型通过低秩适配（LoRA）支持跨下游数据集的高效适配，仅更新生成器参数的 0.60%，且每个数据集约需一小时。在六个下游基准上，GeoSET 通过全量微调或 LoRA 在 FID 和 DISTS 上取得了当前最优结果，展示了跨异构 SAR–EO 域的有效迁移。

title: HLA-WM: Hybrid Linear Attention for Long-Horizon Video World Models
summary: Long-horizon video world models require persistent memory to preserve scene consistency over extended rollouts. Softmax attention retains the full generation history through a growing KV cache, whereas recurrent linear attention compresses history into fixed-size states with substantially lower memory cost. However, we identify severe long-range forgetting in Gated DeltaNet (GDN), where information from distant but relevant scenes is progressively attenuated by subsequent state updates. To address this limitation, we propose HLA-WM, a training-free hybrid linear-attention framework that combines coarse-grained geometry-guided retrieval with fine-grained recurrent linear-state computation. HLA-WM exploits the affine structure of GDN to cache compact chunk-wise transition summaries, retrieve scene-relevant historical chunks using camera geometry, and recompose them into query-specific recurrent states. On the 60-second SANA-WM-Bench, HLA-WM improves all six aggregate revisit-consistency and camera-control metrics of the base autoregressive generator without additional training, including a 0.74 dB PSNR gain and a 28.5% reduction in rotation error. The improvements persist after downstream refinement and generalize to MBench-A, where HLA-WM consistently improves all three revisit-consistency metrics across all four subsets and all evaluated inference modes over 547 samples. At a 60-second context, HLA-WM reduces historical-state memory by 12times relative to full KV caching while incurring at most a 1.6% reduction in inference throughput. These results demonstrate that selectively addressable recurrent memory can improve long-range scene recall while preserving the efficiency advantages of GDN. Project page: https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/
translation:
标题：HLA-WM：面向长时程视频世界模型的混合线性注意力
摘要：长时程视频世界模型需要持久记忆，以在扩展推演过程中保持场景一致性。Softmax 注意力通过不断增长的 KV 缓存保留完整生成历史，而循环线性注意力则将历史压缩为固定大小的状态，内存开销显著更低。然而，我们发现 Gated DeltaNet (GDN) 存在严重的长程遗忘问题：来自相距较远但相关场景的信息会随后续状态更新而逐步衰减。为缓解这一局限，我们提出 HLA-WM，一种免训练的混合线性注意力框架，将粗粒度几何引导检索与细粒度循环线性状态计算相结合。HLA-WM 利用 GDN 的仿射结构缓存紧凑的分块转移摘要，使用相机几何检索与场景相关的历史块，并将其重组为查询特定的循环状态。在 60 秒 SANA-WM-Bench 上，HLA-WM 无需额外训练即在基础自回归生成器的全部六项重访一致性与相机控制综合指标上取得提升，包括 0.74 dB 的 PSNR 增益和 28.5% 的旋转误差降低。这些改进在下游精炼后依然保持，并可泛化至 MBench-A；在 547 个样本上，HLA-WM 在全部四个子集和所有评估的推理模式中均一致提升了全部三项重访一致性指标。在 60 秒上下文下，相较于完整 KV 缓存，HLA-WM 将历史状态内存降至其 1/12，而推理吞吐量最多仅下降 1.6%。这些结果表明，可选择性寻址的循环记忆能够提升长程场景召回能力，同时保持 GDN 的效率优势。项目页面：https://caesarhhh.github.io/hla-wm/

title: Learning to Learn a Language
summary: We present the Prior-Fitted Language Model (PFLM), a 300M-parameter byte-level transformer pretrained only on samples from a synthetic non-linguistic prior. Given a prefix of real text, it learns to predict the language in context with frozen weights, having never seen a word of any real language. Every training sequence is generated by a recurrent structural causal model drawn fresh from a distribution over such models. The model never sees the same language twice during training, so the only way to predict the continuation is to infer the language from the prefix. Samples from this prior share the statistical signatures of natural text: Zipfian frequencies, slow entropy-rate convergence, and long-range dependence. On Wikipedia in six languages, bits per byte fall from the uniform eight to between 0.9 and 2.4 at one million bytes of context. Given numerals instead of text, PFLM learns to count, to compare magnitudes, and to add approximately. It predicts deterministic sequences like Rudin-Shapiro or the prime indicator, and it compresses six non-text domains, from source code to speech, below gzip and PPMd. The model has not learned a language. It has learned to learn one.
translation:
标题：学会学习一门语言

摘要：我们提出了先验拟合语言模型（PFLM），这是一个具有3亿参数的字节级Transformer，仅在一个合成非语言先验的样本上进行预训练。给定真实文本的前缀，它能够在权重冻结的情况下学习在上下文中预测语言，尽管它从未见过任何真实语言的一个词。每个训练序列都由一个从此类模型分布中重新抽取的循环结构因果模型生成。模型在训练期间从未两次见到同一语言，因此预测后续内容的唯一方式是从前缀中推断语言。来自该先验的样本具有自然文本的统计特征：齐普夫频率、缓慢的熵率收敛以及长程依赖性。在六种语言的维基百科上，每字节比特数从均匀分布的8下降到上下文达到一百万字节时的0.9至2.4之间。给定数字而非文本时，PFLM学会了计数、比较大小以及近似加法。它能够预测诸如Rudin-Shapiro序列或素数指示序列等确定性序列，并且将六个非文本领域（从源代码到语音）压缩至低于gzip和PPMd的水平。该模型并未学会一门语言。它学会了学习一门语言。

title: OpenRUA: Robot-Use Agents Are Zero-Shot Visuomotor Policies
summary: Coding agents are extending their reach into the physical world by writing and executing robot control programs. One might expect the agents to use the existing mature software stack that engineers have developed over decades to access sensors and control motion. Yet prior work primarily engineers complex custom harnesses to orchestrate agents for robot use, particularly by prescribing specialized workflows and providing bespoke interfaces. This raises the question: "Is such additional harness engineering necessary?" We introduce OpenRUA, a zero-abstraction harness that bypasses bespoke abstraction layers by providing off-the-shelf coding agents with only terminal access to the robot's native software interface ROS 2. OpenRUA employs a minimalist workspace-as-harness design, only offering ROS 2 documentation and basic tools while leaving the coding agent to organize its own work without orchestrating any agentic workflow. Within this workspace, OpenRUA recasts perception as file I/O and manipulation as coding. With Claude Code powered by Claude Opus 5, OpenRUA achieves success rates of 99.0% on CaP-Bench and 87.0% on LIBERO-PRO, demonstrating that an off-the-shelf coding agent can serve as a zero-shot visuomotor policy through the robot's native interface, without bespoke primitives or task-specific training. Under this minimalist design, further analysis reveals striking emergent behaviors of coding agents: (1) For perception, the agent spontaneously writes programs that process raw sensory inputs and derive metric measurements in 96.80% of episodes. (2) For manipulation, the agent spontaneously builds motion-control clients (e.g., gripper control) in 95.87% of episodes and closed-loop control programs (e.g., adjusting motion based on sensor feedback) in 50.13% of episodes. Our code is available at https://github.com/terminalworld/OpenRUA.
translation:
标题：OpenRUA：机器人使用智能体是零样本视觉运动策略

摘要：编码智能体正通过编写并执行机器人控制程序，将其能力延伸至物理世界。人们可能会期望这些智能体利用工程师数十年来开发的现成成熟软件栈来访问传感器并控制运动。然而，已有工作主要构建复杂的定制框架来编排智能体以使用机器人，尤其是通过规定专门的工作流并提供定制接口。这引出了一个问题：“这种额外的框架工程是否必要？”我们提出OpenRUA，一种零抽象框架，通过仅向现成的编码智能体提供对机器人原生软件接口ROS 2的终端访问，绕过定制抽象层。OpenRUA采用极简的工作空间即框架设计，仅提供ROS 2文档和基本工具，同时让编码智能体自行组织工作，而不编排任何智能体工作流。在该工作空间中，OpenRUA将感知重构为文件I/O，将操作重构为编码。在由Claude Opus 5驱动的Claude Code支持下，OpenRUA在CaP-Bench上达到99.0%的成功率，在LIBERO-PRO上达到87.0%的成功率，表明现成的编码智能体可以通过机器人原生接口充当零样本视觉运动策略，而无需定制原语或任务特定训练。在这一极简设计下，进一步分析揭示了编码智能体引人注目的涌现行为：（1）在感知方面，智能体在96.80%的回合中自发编写程序来处理原始感官输入并推导度量测量值。（2）在操作方面，智能体在95.87%的回合中自发构建运动控制客户端（例如夹爪控制），并在50.13%的回合中自发构建闭环控制程序（例如根据传感器反馈调整运动）。我们的代码可在https://github.com/terminalworld/OpenRUA获取。

title: Periscope: Extending Frozen Language Models Beyond Their Context Window
summary: A language model reads long text in one quadratic forward pass, stops at the context window, and loses accuracy with length before reaching it. We ask whether the read can be factorized when deciding over a finite set: which document is relevant, which option is supported, which passage is the evidence. Periscope, a training-free inference method, arranges the N chunks of a text on a K{times}K grid with K{=}lceilNrceil and asks a frozen model the same question about K local spans of consecutive chunks and K strided spans that sample the whole text, reading the log-odds of every answer at one token. Each answer takes its best local and strided score, and scoring every chunk by its two spans gives an evidence map at no further cost, whose peak is the chunk behind the answer. Every probe is about sc tokens for a text of s tokens and chunk size c, so a window of W tokens reaches W^{2}/c tokens at s^{1.5} cost. The map replaces the long read. On LongBench v2, reading only the K chunks the map ranks highest, 9k tokens, matches the same model's best window read across windows from 32k to 1M tokens, and on InfiniteBench, where the median context is 150k tokens, it leads the best window read by 5 points. The same map ranks BRIGHT's long-document corpora with the best NDCG@10 of six methods. Each call caches only one probe, so a 27B model reads 4.5M-token contexts on one 80GB GPU, where a single pass would need 296GB of cache. A long read then needs a GPU that holds the model, not one that holds the text.
translation:
标题：Periscope：将冻结语言模型扩展至其上下文窗口之外

摘要：语言模型通过一次二次前向传播读取长文本，会在上下文窗口处停止，并且在尚未达到该窗口时准确率就随长度增加而下降。我们探究：当在有限集合上做决策时——哪篇文档相关、哪个选项得到支持、哪段文字是证据——这种读取能否被分解？Periscope 是一种免训练推理方法，它将文本的 N 个块排列在 K×K 网格上，其中 K=⌈√N⌉，并就 K 个连续块的局部跨度和 K 个采样整个文本的跨步跨度，向冻结模型提出同一问题，同时在单个 token 上读取每个答案的对数几率。每个答案取其局部与跨步评分中的最佳值；以每个块的两个跨度对其评分，可在不增加额外成本的情况下得到证据图，其峰值即支撑答案的块。对于长度为 s 个 token 的文本和块大小 c，每次探针约涉及 √(s c) 个 token，因此一个 W token 的窗口以 s^{1.5} 的代价覆盖 W²/c 个 token。该证据图取代了长文本读取。在 LongBench v2 上，仅读取证据图排名最高的 K 个块（9k 个 token），即可与同一模型在 32k 到 1M token 窗口范围内的最佳窗口读取表现相当；在 InfiniteBench 上，其中位上下文为 150k 个 token，该方法比最佳窗口读取高出 5 个百分点。同一证据图在 BRIGHT 的长文档语料库排序上，取得了六种方法中最佳的 NDCG@10。每次调用仅缓存一个探针，因此一个 27B 模型可在单张 80GB GPU 上读取 4.5M token 上下文，而单次前向传播需要 296GB 缓存。由此，长文本读取所需的 GPU 只需能容纳模型，而无需能容纳文本。

title: TextReg: Mitigating Prompt Distributional Overfitting via Regularized Text-Space Optimization
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are highly sensitive to the prompts used to specify task objectives and behavioral constraints. Many recent prompt optimization methods iteratively rewrite prompts using LLM-generated feedback, but the resulting prompts often become longer, accumulate narrow sample-specific rules, and generalize poorly beyond the training distribution. We study this failure mode as prompt distributional overfitting and argue that it reflects a lack of representation control in discrete text-space optimization. We formalize this view through representational inefficiency, a dual-factor measure that decomposes prompt inefficiency into capacity cost and scope narrowness, attributing distributional prompt overfitting to their coupled growth during optimization. We propose TextReg, a regularization framework that realizes a soft-penalty objective through regularized textual gradients, combining Dual-Evidence Gradient Purification, Semantic Edit Regularization, and Regularization-Guided Prompt Update. Across multiple reasoning benchmarks, TextReg substantially improves out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization, with accuracy gains of up to +11.8% over TextGrad and +16.5% over REVOLVE.
translation:
标题：TextReg：通过正则化文本空间优化缓解提示分布过拟合

摘要：大型语言模型（LLM）对用于指定任务目标和行为约束的提示高度敏感。近期许多提示优化方法利用LLM生成的反馈迭代重写提示，但由此得到的提示往往变得更长、累积了狭窄的样本特定规则，并且难以泛化至训练分布之外。我们将这一失效模式研究为提示分布过拟合，并认为它反映了离散文本空间优化中表示控制的缺失。我们通过表示低效性对这一观点进行了形式化，该双因素度量将提示低效性分解为容量成本与范围狭窄性，并将分布性提示过拟合归因于二者在优化过程中的耦合增长。我们提出TextReg，一个通过正则化文本梯度实现软惩罚目标的正则化框架，结合了双证据梯度纯化、语义编辑正则化和正则化引导的提示更新。在多个推理基准上，TextReg显著提升了分布外（OOD）泛化能力，相较于TextGrad准确率提升最高达+11.8%，相较于REVOLVE提升最高达+16.5%。

title: OmniConfess: Eliciting Token Confessions to Mitigate Omni-Modal Hallucination
summary: Omni-modal large language models (OmniLLMs) unify text, images, audio, and video, yet hallucinate when generation relies on the wrong evidence. Existing inference-time methods can reduce hallucinations, but rarely reveal which evidence sustains a generated commitment. We introduce OmniConfess, a training-free method for mitigating omni-modal hallucinations. It fixes a candidate response and re-scores it at token resolution under controlled channel-wise evidence interventions, producing a structured token-by-channel confession that reveals the response's evidential dependence. OmniConfess uses this confession to preserve grounded content and correct commitments driven by irrelevant or contradictory evidence. To evaluate OmniConfess, we construct OmniHalluBench, a 3,540-example benchmark built from six datasets spanning text, image, audio, and video settings and both judgment and free-form generation. Experiments show that OmniConfess mitigates hallucinations across heterogeneous modality and task settings. Our code and benchmark are publicly available at https://github.com/RongHuiQiang/OmniConfess.
translation:
标题：OmniConfess：引出Token自白以缓解全模态幻觉

摘要：全模态大语言模型（OmniLLMs）统一了文本、图像、音频和视频，但当生成依赖错误证据时会产生幻觉。现有的推理时方法可以减少幻觉，但很少揭示哪些证据支撑了生成的断言。我们提出OmniConfess，一种无需训练的方法，用于缓解全模态幻觉。它固定一个候选响应，并在受控的通道级证据干预下以Token粒度重新评分，产生结构化的按Token和通道的自白，从而揭示响应的证据依赖性。OmniConfess利用该自白来保留有依据的内容，并纠正由无关或矛盾证据驱动的断言。为评估OmniConfess，我们构建了OmniHalluBench，一个包含3,540个样本的基准，基于六个数据集构建，涵盖文本、图像、音频和视频设置，以及判断和自由形式生成。实验表明，OmniConfess在异构模态和任务设置中缓解了幻觉。我们的代码和基准已公开于 https://github.com/RongHuiQiang/OmniConfess。

title: GeoCR: Learning a Generalist Cloud Removal Prior from Heterogeneous Observations
summary: Cloud removal methods are typically specialized to individual datasets and input configurations, limiting reuse across sensors, spectral bands, and observation settings. We introduce GeoCR, a generalist model that unifies RGB-only-based CR and multispectral-based CR from single- or multi-temporal cloudy observations, with optional SAR guidance, within a single network. To accommodate different spectral and sensing domains, compact input and output stems extend a pretrained RGB autoencoder while keeping its encoder and decoder trunks frozen. This shared latent interface enables a single flow transformer to jointly model clean RGB and non-RGB latents, conditioned on separate cloudy-observation streams and optional SAR tokens. Through joint pretraining on the training splits of ten datasets comprising 883,331 cloud-free target images, GeoCR learns a shared cloud removal prior across these heterogeneous configurations. The same pretrained checkpoint supports direct inference without dataset-specific fine-tuning and efficient adaptation through low-rank adaptation (LoRA). We evaluate GeoCR against general image restoration and cloud removal methods on test splits of the contributing datasets under full-band and RGB-only settings. GeoCR achieves the best FID and DISTS on full-band SEN12MS-CR and Sen2_MTC_New and RGB-only CUHK-CR2, outperforming existing models and demonstrating the effectiveness of a reusable generative model across diverse settings.
translation:
标题：GeoCR：从异构观测中学习通用云去除先验  
摘要：云去除方法通常针对单个数据集和输入配置进行专门设计，限制了跨传感器、光谱波段和观测设置的复用。我们提出 GeoCR，一个通用模型，它在单一网络内统一了基于单时相或多时相含云观测的仅 RGB 的 CR 与基于多光谱的 CR，并可选地引入 SAR 引导。为适应不同的光谱和传感域，紧凑的输入与输出 stem 模块扩展了一个预训练 RGB 自编码器，同时保持其编码器和解码器主干冻结。这一共享潜在接口使单个流 Transformer 能够联合建模干净的 RGB 和非 RGB 潜变量，并以独立的含云观测流和可选的 SAR token 为条件。通过对包含 883,331 张无云目标图像的十个数据集的训练划分进行联合预训练，GeoCR 在这些异构配置间学习到共享的云去除先验。同一预训练检查点支持无需数据集特定微调的直接推理，并可通过低秩适配（LoRA）实现高效适配。我们在全波段和仅 RGB 设置下，在贡献数据集的测试划分上将 GeoCR 与通用图像复原和云去除方法进行对比评估。GeoCR 在全波段的 SEN12MS-CR 和 Sen2_MTC_New 以及仅 RGB 的 CUHK-CR2 上取得了最佳 FID 和 DISTS，优于现有模型，并证明了可复用生成模型在多样化设置中的有效性。

title: SoK: Semantic Decision Engines in Network Control Loops
summary: A semantic decision engine such as Jev can return a valid answer and still miss a network deadline, select an infeasible action or leave the service unverified. We systematize 139 paper families by decision interface, execution path and check ownership. Fifty families claim that their engine fits a control loop or time budget, but only four support the claim with matched measurement. Across all 139, four report deadline attainment. The gap concentrates where the decision has no deterministic computation step. Those 72 families make 22 of the claims, none supported, and name a coverage owner in only two. Bounded tests under one event model show that each gap can reverse an admission verdict. A decision that meets a 10 s budget for every isolated request meets it for none once decisions queue ahead of replayed execution times. The same engine passes one coverage check and fails another. We derive a minimum reporting record, design rules and a research agenda for admitting decision engines to control loops.
translation:
标题：SoK：网络控制回路中的语义决策引擎

摘要：语义决策引擎（如 Jev）可能返回有效答案，却仍然错过网络截止时间、选择不可行动作，或使服务未经验证。我们按决策接口、执行路径和检查归属，对 139 个论文族进行了系统化梳理。五十个论文族声称其引擎适合控制回路或时间预算，但只有四个用相匹配的测量支持该主张。在全部 139 个论文族中，只有四个报告了截止时间达成情况。缺口集中在决策没有确定性计算步骤之处。这 72 个论文族提出了其中 22 项主张，无一得到支持，且仅有两个论文族指明了覆盖责任主体。在单一事件模型下的有界测试表明，每一处缺口都可能逆转准入判定。一个对每个孤立请求均满足 10 秒预算的决策，一旦决策在重放执行时间之前排队，就无法对任何请求满足该预算。同一引擎能通过一项覆盖检查，却无法通过另一项。我们据此推导出最低报告记录、设计规则，以及将决策引擎准入控制回路的研究议程。

title: Intent Interpretation at RIC Timescales: Jev Decision Models versus Large Language Models in 6G Open RAN
summary: Intent-based Open RAN needs an interpreter that turns intents into A1 policies within the loop of the RAN intelligent controller (RIC). Decision models such as Jev-1.13.0 return typed policy fields, whereas generative large language models (LLMs) produce the policy token by token. We ask whether the extra delay of LLMs costs control deadlines, RIC capacity, or radio performance. We compare Jev-1.13.0 and two other decision models with LLMs on the RANIntent v1 benchmark, in closed-loop ns-3 simulation and on a real A1 and E2 path. Median interpretation takes 0.286 to 2.35 s, against under 25 ms for A1 and E2 transfer. Jev-1.13.0 meets the 1 s near-real-time budget on 99.8% of calls, while two hosted LLMs meet it on 17.9% and 0%. In the radio network, ideal enforcement moves the affected-class service-level agreement (SLA) violation by 3.96 percentage points in the direction each intent requests, against no update at the base point. No hosted LLM showed a resolved increase over Jev-1.13.0 at that point. At the same point, per-second direct control gave no resolved SLA reduction over a numerical xApp. Slow interpreters miss the 1 s budget, and two interpreters saturate their queues at 2 intents/s, whereas no radio penalty of slow interpreters was resolved at the base point.
translation:
标题：RIC时间尺度下的意图解释：6G开放无线接入网中Jev决策模型与大型语言模型的对比

摘要：基于意图的开放无线接入网需要一个解释器，在无线接入网智能控制器（RIC）的环路内将意图转换为A1策略。诸如Jev-1.13.0之类的决策模型返回类型化的策略字段，而生成式大型语言模型（LLM）则逐词元生成策略。我们探究LLM的额外延迟是否会影响控制截止时间、RIC容量或无线性能。我们在RANIntent v1基准上，通过闭环ns-3仿真以及在真实A1和E2路径上，将Jev-1.13.0及其他两种决策模型与LLM进行对比。意图解释的中位耗时为0.286至2.35秒，而A1和E2传输耗时低于25毫秒。Jev-1.13.0在99.8%的调用中满足1秒的近实时预算，而两个托管LLM分别仅在17.9%和0%的调用中满足该预算。在无线网络中，理想执行使受影响类别的服务等级协议（SLA）违约率沿各意图所要求的方向变化3.96个百分点，而基点处无更新。在该点上，没有托管LLM相对于Jev-1.13.0表现出统计显著的改善。在同一时间点上，每秒直接控制相较于数值xApp未产生统计显著的SLA降低。慢速解释器无法满足1秒预算，且两个解释器在每秒2个意图的负载下出现队列饱和，而在基点处未发现慢速解释器造成无线性能损失。

title: Learning Steadily: Accumulating Relative Point Margin Scores for Face Image Quality Assessment
summary: Face Image Quality Assessment determines the suitability of captured face images for automated face recognition (FR), a critical capability for reliable biometric systems. Existing state-of-the-art FR-integrated FIQA methods suffer from temporal instability: as the feature space evolves during training, single-epoch quality estimates fluctuate, creating a moving target that undermines reliable quality prediction. We introduce CARPM-FIQA, a stabilization strategy for FR-integrated FIQA that accumulates relative point margin measurements, the ratio between intra-class compactness and inter-class separation, across the entire training trajectory rather than relying on single-epoch estimates. This cumulative averaging approach provides theoretically grounded advantages: reduced variance in quality estimates, improved mean squared error, and enhanced ranking stability with convergence guarantees as training progresses. Through controlled experiments on the SynFIQA dataset with labeled quality groups, we demonstrate that cumulative averaging achieves superior discriminative ability, and ablation studies across different training configurations confirm consistent improvements. Evaluated against twelve FIQA methods on eight challenging benchmarks with four FR models at two FMR thresholds, CARPM-FIQA places 4th (CARPM-FIQA(L)) and 6th (CARPM-FIQA(S)) of 17 compared methods by pAUC-EDC and AUC-EDC averaged across FR models and, after per-benchmark normalization, across benchmarks, staying within a few percent of the best method's normalized average for every FR model, providing a principled solution to training instability while maintaining the performance benefits of FR integration. More broadly, our work demonstrates that temporal aggregation strategies can stabilize training objectives in deep learning systems where target values inherently fluctuate due to evolving feature representations.
translation:
标题：稳步学习：累积相对点间隔分数用于人脸图像质量评估

摘要：人脸图像质量评估（FIQA）决定所采集的人脸图像是否适合用于自动人脸识别（FR），这是可靠生物特征识别系统的关键能力。现有最先进的 FR 集成式 FIQA 方法存在时间不稳定性：随着训练过程中特征空间不断演化，单轮次质量估计会发生波动，形成移动目标，从而削弱可靠的质量预测。我们提出 CARPM-FIQA，一种面向 FR 集成式 FIQA 的稳定化策略。该策略在整个训练轨迹上累积相对点间隔度量，即类内紧凑性与类间分离度之比，而非依赖单轮次估计。这种累积平均方法具有理论支撑的优势：降低质量估计的方差、改善均方误差，并增强排序稳定性，且随着训练推进具有收敛保证。通过在带有质量组标签的 SynFIQA 数据集上进行受控实验，我们证明累积平均能够取得更优的判别能力；不同训练配置下的消融研究也证实了一致的改进。在八项具有挑战性的基准上，使用四个 FR 模型和两个 FMR 阈值，与十二种 FIQA 方法进行比较评估时，在跨 FR 模型平均、并在逐基准归一化后跨基准平均的 pAUC-EDC 和 AUC-EDC 指标上，CARPM-FIQA 在 17 种对比方法中，CARPM-FIQA(L) 位列第 4，CARPM-FIQA(S) 位列第 6；对于每个 FR 模型，其与最佳方法归一化平均值之间的差距均保持在几个百分点以内，从而在保持 FR 集成性能优势的同时，为训练不稳定性提供了一种有原则的解决方案。更广泛地说，我们的工作表明，在目标值因特征表示不断演化而固有波动的深度学习系统中，时间聚合策略能够稳定训练目标。

title: CurveCodec 2: Skeleton-agnostic animation compression with a learned entropy model
summary: Skeletal motion is stored as every joint's transform at every frame, yet most of it is implied by the body rather than by what the motion is about. Compression is one way to ask what a motion must still say once the body is known, and a production codec must answer it for any skeleton with a stated error bound. Our earlier codec, CurveCodec, matched the mean error of ACL, the production library of modern game engines, with a learned prior over sparse anchors, but not ACL's worst case, and it counted its payload as floats rather than bits. Here we ask where the redundancy of skeletal motion lies and which part of a codec a learned model should take over. Measurements give three answers. At production precision the largest saving comes from predicting each quantized curve from its own past, the second from choosing per joint, in closed loop through the hierarchy, which samples not to code. On the gaps such an encoder leaves, a nearest-neighbour oracle over millions of training samples is no better than linear interpolation, and no learned in-betweener we tried paid for itself. What a network does learn is the distribution of the residuals the codec must send. CurveCodec 2 codes every sub-track as a curve in the log map, quantized in closed loop and thinned to rate-distortion-selected keys, with residuals entropy-coded under a small learned model whose integer inference is bit-exact across platforms. Two contracts are verified on every decoded clip: ACL's own worst case per joint within a stated tolerance, or ACL's mean error per clip. On a held-out test side of 4,472 clips from 33 datasets, CurveCodec 2 needs 0.37x ACL's bytes at ACL's default precision of 0.01 cm under the worst-case contract and 0.22x at 0.1 cm under the mean contract, decodes on one CPU core, and transfers without retraining to a species absent from training. Project page: https://rubbly.cn/publications/curvecodec/

标题：CurveCodec 2：基于学习熵模型的骨架无关动画压缩

摘要：骨骼运动以每一帧中每个关节的变换形式存储，但其中大部分信息由身体结构所隐含，而非由运动本身的语义所决定。压缩是一种追问方式：在已知身体后，运动还必须表达什么；而生产级编解码器必须对任意骨架在给定误差界下回答这一问题。我们此前的编解码器 CurveCodec 利用稀疏锚点上的学习先验，在平均误差上匹配了现代游戏引擎的生产库 ACL，但未能匹配 ACL 的最坏情况，且其载荷以浮点数而非比特数计量。本文探究骨骼运动的冗余位于何处，以及学习模型应接管编解码器的哪一部分。测量结果给出三个答案。在生产精度下，最大的节省来自利用每条量化曲线自身的历史对其进行预测；第二大节省来自通过层级结构以闭环方式逐关节选择哪些样本不编码。对于此类编码器留下的空缺，即便使用覆盖数百万训练样本的最近邻 oracle，也不优于线性插值；我们尝试过的学习式补间器也都无法抵偿自身开销。网络真正学到的是编解码器必须发送的残差分布。CurveCodec 2 将每条子轨迹编码为对数映射中的曲线，在闭环中量化，并稀疏化为按率失真选择的关键点；残差在一个小型学习模型下进行熵编码，该模型的整数推理在不同平台间比特精确。对每个解码片段验证两种契约：在给定容差内达到 ACL 自身的逐关节最坏情况误差，或达到 ACL 的每片段平均误差。在来自 33 个数据集的 4,472 个片段的留出测试集上，在最坏情况契约下、ACL 默认精度 0.01 cm 时，CurveCodec 2 所需字节数为 ACL 的 0.37 倍；在平均误差契约下、0.1 cm 时为 0.22 倍。它可在单个 CPU 核心上解码，并能无需重新训练迁移到训练中未出现的物种。项目主页：https://rubbly.cn/publications/curvecodec/

title: Arm-wise Compositional Generalization in Dual-Arm Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Generalization in multi-arm collaboration can be studied as composing familiar atomic skills in new ways across arms. However, existing evaluations offer limited insight into which training and architectural choices support this ability under different coordination requirements. We introduce ACG-Bench, a benchmark for Arm-wise Compositional Generalization that provides a common testbed for studying skill recomposition in dual-arm policies. It contains 23 task--condition pairs across 8 task families, with 6 in-domain conditions and 17 unseen compositions covering reordering, synchronization, their combination, and cross-task composition. All methods receive the same per-arm atomic prompts, and success requires achieving the task goal while satisfying physical milestones and specified order or timing constraints. Using π_{0.5} as a common vision-language-action backbone, we compare representative data-augmentation and architectural strategies with shared source data and a common evaluation protocol. Our architectural study examines arm-token grouping, skill-specific LoRA adapters (SkillLoRA), and arm-wise attention (AWA), highlighting the complementarity of skill-conditioned parameters and attention structure. Combining these choices yields AE-VLA, which achieves 21.53\% generalization success in simulation, compared with 2.94\% for Single π_{0.5}, 3.06\% for MA-VLA, and 5.53\% for two independently controlled π_{0.5} policies. On physical SO101 robots, AE-VLA reaches 39.00\% mean success across five unseen conditions, compared with 10.00\% for the strongest baseline. These findings provide empirical guidance for designing dual-arm policies that generalize beyond fixed training routines.

标题：双臂视觉-语言-动作模型中的臂级组合泛化

摘要：多臂协作中的泛化可被研究为跨臂以新方式组合熟悉的原子技能。然而，现有评估对于在不同协调需求下哪些训练与架构选择能够支持该能力，所提供的见解有限。我们提出 ACG-Bench，一个面向臂级组合泛化的基准，为研究双臂策略中的技能重组提供了通用测试平台。它包含跨 8 个任务族的 23 个任务–条件对，其中 6 个域内条件和 17 个未见组合，涵盖重排序、同步、二者组合以及跨任务组合。所有方法均接收相同的各臂原子提示，成功需要在满足物理里程碑以及指定顺序或时序约束的同时达成任务目标。我们以 π_{0.5} 作为通用视觉-语言-动作骨干，在共享源数据和通用评估协议下比较了具有代表性的数据增强策略和架构策略。我们的架构研究考察了臂 token 分组、技能专用 LoRA 适配器（SkillLoRA）和臂级注意力（AWA），凸显了技能条件化参数与注意力结构之间的互补性。将这些选择相结合得到 AE-VLA，其在仿真中取得 21.53% 的泛化成功率；作为对比，Single π_{0.5} 为 2.94%，MA-VLA 为 3.06%，两个独立控制的 π_{0.5} 策略为 5.53%。在实体 SO101 机器人上，AE-VLA 在五个未见条件下达到 39.00% 的平均成功率，而最强基线为 10.00%。这些发现为设计能够泛化到固定训练流程之外的双臂策略提供了实证指导。
